name: Path of Wild Magic
summary: A barbarian whose rage releases unpredictable surges of magic.

features.name: Magic Awareness
features.short: Action: sense spells and magic items within 60 ft.
features.summary: As an action, you sense the location of any spell or magic item within 60 ft. that isn't behind total cover, and learn the school of any spell. Uses: PB per long rest.

features.name: Wild Surge
features.short: When you rage, roll for a random magical effect.
features.summary: When you enter your rage, roll on the Wild Magic table: effects include a burst of necrotic damage, teleporting, a magic weapon, an exploding light, flowers, and more. Effects that need saves use DC 8 + PB + CON.

features.name: Bolstering Magic
features.short: Touch someone: +1d3 to attacks/checks or restore a low slot.
features.summary: As an action, touch a creature: it adds 1d3 to attack rolls and ability checks for 10 minutes, or recovers an expended spell slot of a level you roll on 1d3. Uses: PB per long rest.

features.name: Unstable Backlash
features.short: When hurt or forced to save while raging, reroll your surge.
features.summary: When you are imperiled while raging (you take damage or fail a save), you can use your reaction to roll on the Wild Magic table, replacing your current effect.

features.name: Controlled Surge
features.short: Roll twice on the surge table and pick the effect.
features.summary: Whenever you roll on the Wild Magic table, roll twice and choose which result to use. If both are the same, choose any effect on the table.
